name: Lane Thresher

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The thresher makes two Gore attacks.

Actions.name: Gore
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 19 (4d6 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the thresher moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

Actions.name: Dusting Trample (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 49 (14d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

Bonus Actions.name: Trample
Bonus Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. *Failure:* 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Traits.name: Unbroken Charge
Traits.text: When its movement is interrupted or reduced by Difficult Terrain, a Prone creature's space, or a creature falling Prone in its path, the thresher doesn't stop; it continues its move along the same line and can still make its Gore attacks, and if it drops a creature Prone during this move it can move through that creature's space without slowing.

Traits.name: Shearing Skull
Traits.text: The thresher ignores Difficult Terrain, and it can move through the space of any Prone creature of its size or smaller without that space counting as Difficult Terrain.
Traits.clause: The thresher's flat, blade-edged skull is the tool of its whole life: it is not slowed by Difficult Terrain, and it can
Traits.expresses: keeps running through the fallen and comes back around
Traits.expressedQuote: it can move through the space of any Prone creature of its size or smaller without that space counting as Difficult Terrain

lore: A hog-sized plains beast of dense bone and hide, it evolved to cross open ground at speed through herds too thick to go around, and it now reads any crowd as a herd that has not yet been parted.

generation.userConcept: a thresher-beast that charges in a straight line, knocks everything flat, and keeps going
generation.cite: composition after Gorgon (CR 5) — charge plus a breath-shaped nova
